name: Eastern Scientific Inc

about:
Eastern Scientific Inc. (ESI) was founded in 1978 in Baltimore, Maryland. The company began as a technology-focused representative firm, partnering with manufacturers to bring advanced equipment to market.

ESI does not manufacture products itself; instead, it represents a portfolio of manufacturers supplying capital equipment and components for semiconductor, solar, optical, and industrial vacuum applications. Its services include market introduction, technology commercialization, and technical support for equipment such as metrology tools, deposition systems, plasma generators, and etch systems. The firm has also assisted in launching four capital-equipment startups targeting hard-disk drives, optical filters, superconductor wire, and flexible solar panels.

The company serves research institutions including MIT, Harvard, Princeton, Dartmouth, and Johns Hopkins, as well as original equipment manufacturers such as KLA, Brooks Automation, Varian, and Tokyo Electron, and device makers like IBM, GlobalFoundries, Analog Devices, Cree, Intel, and Texas Instruments. Its coverage spans the semiconductor, solar, optical, and industrial vacuum sectors.

ESI states its mission is to provide leading-edge technology companies with the next generation of manufacturing equipment, remaining committed to meeting future demands through its network of manufacturer partnerships.
